InteractiveHoverLinks.description: Large kinetic text links list for interest categories (Dancing, Gaming, Sports, Writing, Singing). Revealing a floating cursor-following image + arrow on hover.
InteractiveHoverLinks.behavior: Uses framer-motion for smooth position tracking of floating image preview and rotation tilt.

KineticHero.description: Line-by-line masked text reveal on page load, 3D tilt card hero visual (CSS 3D perspective + framer-motion mouse movement tilt, zero heavy dependencies).

EditorialMarquee.description: Slow, smooth drifting marquee banner showcasing categories, departments, and live connection highlights with high visual polish.

steps: Step 1: Identity & Phone (Full Name, Phone Number, Optional Avatar)
Step 2: Interest Categories Multi-Select (Dancing, Gaming, Sports, Writing, Singing) with Unsplash Image Cards & Active Check Badges
Step 3: Department Select (B.Tech, BE, MBA, CDAC, Pharmacy) with badge tags
Step 4: Consent-Based Location Sharing Toggle (Clear explanation: Location is shared ONLY on request with explicit approval)
Step 5: Completion Confirmation & Immediate Redirect to Directory

DirectoryAndFilter.description: Directory grid of registered members with live search by name, category filter tabs, department filter pills, and Location Request actions.
features: Member Card with badges, interests, and Request Location CTA

ConsentLocationManager.description: Consent-first location sharing engine & Notification Inbox
rules: No automatic or covert location tracking
Explicit Request -> Target user receives inbox alert ('User X requests your approximate location')
Target user approves/declines via Browser Geolocation API consent UI
Active shared locations show approximate distance, timestamp, and a prominent REVOKE LOCATION SHARING button

instructions_to_main_agent: Build InteractiveHoverLinks in /src/components/ui/interactive-hover-links.js with cursor-following floating image & tilt arrow
Build clear consent-first privacy banner & modal flow for location sharing
Include pre-seeded mock users with departments (B.Tech, BE, MBA, CDAC, Pharmacy) and interest categories
Ensure all key buttons, inputs, tabs, cards have explicit data-testid attributes
Use smooth Lenis scroll feel or framer-motion smooth transitions throughout
